Health and Physical Education is the study of well-being, health, relationships, human
development, and participation in physical activity, games, and sport.

Health and Physical Education helps students understand themselves and others,
supporting their sense of self, relationships, and lifelong participation in active and
healthy lives.

Health and Physical Education equips students with knowledge to understand
interconnected aspects of physical and mental health and relationships with others.
Students will develop technical and tactical skills, health and safety knowledge for
being in the outdoors, and understanding of development in sport. This knowledge is
then used to make informed decisions, understand diverse perspectives, and
participate in healthy and active lives.

The Health and Physical Education learning area prepares students with the
knowledge and practices to access related curriculum subjects for Years 11–13.
